authoritativeBehaviors: header actions, section control, and sticky snap behavior

authoritativeBehaviors: keyboard, pointer, focus, and reset behavior
tests/e2e/forms.spec.ts.reason: Forms keep cross-browser coverage for association, keyboard, pointer, focus, and native control behavior; token-backed recipes may opt into Chromium.

authoritativeBehaviors: choice traversal, filtering, and active descendant behavior
tests/e2e/selects.spec.ts.reason: Selects keep cross-browser coverage for popup positioning, focus, keyboard, scrolling, and form behavior; static recipes may opt into Chromium.

authoritativeBehaviors: shell scrolling, focus entry, persistence, and chrome motion
tests/e2e/shell-app-chrome.spec.ts.reason: Shell chrome keeps cross-browser coverage for responsive measurement, focus, scrolling, persistence, and animation lifecycle; static chrome recipes may opt into Chromium.

authoritativeBehaviors: application-owned tool identity across responsive handoff
tests/e2e/shell-mobile.spec.ts.reason: Mobile shell keeps cross-browser coverage for direct touch, responsive handoff, persistent owner identity, and presentation transitions; static chrome recipes may opt into Chromium.

authoritativeBehaviors: managed page and tool identity across presentations
tests/e2e/shell-managed.spec.ts.reason: Managed ShellApp owns configuration wiring and application-owned node identity; it does not repeat the detailed desktop or mobile chrome geometry owned by the adjacent shell suites.
